_comment: Static App Store reviews rendered verbatim on the landing page. Edit this file to change what the reviews section shows - no HTML changes needed. Text is verbatim from the App Store product page (screenshots supplied by the team, 21 Sep 2026); typos and punctuation are intentionally untouched. Cards render in source order. With fewer than 3 entries the grid collapses to the number present, with no empty slot.

reviews.title: Exactly what I need
reviews.body: My cycle is crazy irregular but FemFast still gives me clear steps. No other fasting app did that. Total gamechanger.

reviews.title: Really nice app!
reviews.body: I have PCOS and it’s tough finding advice that doesn’t make me feel broken. This app is gentle but also science-based. Exactly what I needed.
